exposure: cervical HPV infection (types 16/18, other high-risk types)
mutual genital hygiene prior to intercourse
outcome: incidence of lower genital tract infections (chlamydia, gonococcal infections, mycobacterial diseases)
cohort: A total of 531 women from three provinces in China, categorized into HPV-positive or HPV-negative groups, participated in the study.
finding: Infections with HPV type 16/18, especially when accompanied by abnormal cytological findings, significantly elevate anxiety and distress in women and are associated with reduced female sexual function scores.
cross-section timing: At the time of cervical cancer screening and assessment
